units.source_text: 这件事发生之后，阿住又想惦记起招赘女婿的事情了。

en.t: After this happened, Azhu began thinking again about finding a live-in son-in-law.

units.source_text: 之前是担心生计问题，也担心邻居们的闲言碎语，才想要替阿民招赘丈夫。

en.t: Before, she had wanted to arrange a husband for Amin because she worried about their livelihood and about the neighbors' gossip.

units.source_text: 即便是为了逃开一时的劳务，因此她就惦记为阿民招赘丈夫这件事了。

en.t: Even if it was only to escape a temporary spell of labor, she therefore started thinking about finding a husband for Amin.

units.source_text: 所以比起之前，这次他想为阿民招赘丈夫的态度就更加坚决了。

en.t: So compared with before, his attitude this time toward finding a husband for Amin became even more determined.
